about_the_game:
Control Cururu, a bullfrog native to Brazil’s fauna, on a spiritual journey to purify a world consumed by corruption.

The deep corruption of the miasma is eroding the minds of mortals and spirits alike. Desperate and alone, one of the last spirits of the forest — Naiá, the Spirit of the Water Lily — chooses a hero. Now, a young cururu bullfrog must embark on a journey of self-discovery to save the land he calls home before the corruption devours everything.

Cururu: Whispers of the Forest is a 2D Metroidvania deeply rooted in Brazilian culture. Explore biomes reimagined in a Naturepunk aesthetic, solve puzzles, evolve your abilities, face corrupted animals and spirits, and unlock new paths using the purifying power of water.

Highlights

  • A 100% Brazilian protagonist
    Live the adventure as Cururu, a forest bullfrog, and explore the world with agile jumps, an extendable tongue, and water-based powers.

  • Explore a reimagined Brazil
    Travel through biomes inspired by the Atlantic Forest, Amazon, Cerrado, and beyond — each featuring unique and vibrant fauna, an organic soundtrack, and a Naturepunk setting blending myth and nature.

  • Waters that shape the world
    Wield the Gourd of Waters to overcome physical and spiritual challenges. Purify the land, interact with the environment, and free animals and spirits corrupted by the presence of miasma.

  • Allies and enemies from Brazilian folklore
    Encounter enchanted beings such as Boitatá, Saci-Pererê, and Curupira, along with native Brazilian animals reimagined as spiritual guardians and corrupted creatures.

  • Discover, evolve, and purify
    Collect seeds, fruits, and magical talismans that awaken new abilities and transform the world around you. Each power unlocked opens new paths and reveals ancient secrets of the forest.

  • A unique artistic identity
    2D visuals with hand-drawn illustrations and fluid animation inspired by modern cartoons and regional art styles.

  • A spiritual narrative
    A tale of healing, connection, and resistance, woven with poetic layers for players of all ages.

short_description: After the fall of humanity, nature blooms. In a Naturepunk vision of Brazil rooted in ancestral spirit, follow the journey of Cururu, a young frog imbued with sacred water powers, as he purifies biomes and explores folklore in a tale of healing and redemption.
